rv.q: It's also a telling symptom of a play that doesn't always know where its real strengths lie.
Can a play provocatively titled Prince Faggot actually be a philosophical meditation of queer identity? In this case, yes.

cn.t: Tannahill's speculative royal drama earns praise for boldly venturing into taboo territory with its provocative premise about a future heir to the throne, creating an immersive theatrical experience that pushes boundaries.
